steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic app structure, package names, and environment declarations inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Define Project Build Settings
steps.description: Configure the app/build.gradle to target Android SDK 34 using Java 8 compiler options and Gradle 8.5 compatibility settings, and remove third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Define standard system capabilities, declare Android Internet permissions in AndroidManifest.xml, and remove deprecated inline package attributes.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the user interface layout in activity_main.xml with input fields, progress indicators, action buttons, and correct layout_width values to prevent AAPT compilation failures.

steps.title: Design SMTP Settings Dialog Layout
steps.description: Build an input dialog interface in dialog_settings.xml supporting host, port, SMTP credentials (email address, secure app password), and SSL protocol toggles.

steps.title: Implement SmtpListener Interface
steps.description: Define the SmtpListener callback interface inside MainActivity to capture interactive SMTP negotiation stages and failures.

steps.title: Build Low-Level Native SMTP Client Socket
steps.description: Construct SmtpClient.java using standard Java SSLSocketFactory and Raw Socket stream controls to run authentic SMTP protocol exchange with Gmail servers without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Initialization
steps.description: Setup views inside MainActivity.java and read initial configuration parameters from SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Integrate Settings Save and Load Framework
steps.description: Integrate persistent SharedPreferences mechanisms inside MainActivity settings dialog to manage user SMTP configs seamlessly.

steps.title: Implement Background Thread Dispatch and Logs Display
steps.description: Construct execution triggers in MainActivity to dispatch SMTP commands safely on background worker threads and continuously print status responses to the live console scroll view.

steps.title: Building Gmail SMTP Mailer
steps.description: Validate build files and initialize compilation targeting the correct platform build requirements.
